players.bio: Alberto Dossena (born 13 October 1998) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Como. Dossena made his professional debut in the Serie B for Perugia on 4 March 2017 in a game against Avellino. On 2 August 2019, he joined Alessandria on loan. On 15 September 2020 Dossena joined Avellino, with Atalanta retaining a buyback option.

Alberto Moreno Pérez (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 5 July 1992) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Como. An academy graduate of local side Sevilla, he made his senior debut for the club's reserve side in 2011 before going on to feature in 62 official games for the first team.
Álex Valle Gómez (born 25 April 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club Como.
Assane Diao Diaoune (born 7 September 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Como. Born in Senegal, he is a youth international for Spain.

Edoardo Goldaniga (born 2 November 1993) is an Italian professional footballer who plays a defender for Serie A club Como. Goldaniga is part of the Italy U21 squad since April 2014, selected by coach Luigi Di Biagio, with whom he made his debut on 4 June 2014 in a friendly match against Montenegro. He has also featured for the Italy U20 squad on three occasions.
Jacobo Ramón Naveros (born 6 January 2005) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Como
Jayden Osei Addai (born 26 August 2005) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Como.
Jean Butez (born 8 June 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Como.
Jesús Rodriguez Caraballo (born 21 November 2005) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a winger for Como
Lucas Da Cunha (born 9 June 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Como.

Lucas Da Cunha (born 9 June 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Como, which he captains. Club career Da Cunha is a youth product of Rennes. In the final of the 2018–19 Championnat National U19, he scored a hat-trick to help his team lift the trophy. In December 2017, Da Cunha signed his first professional contract with Rennes.

Luis Milla Manzanares (born 7 October 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club Como 1907. Milla's father, also named Luis, was also a footballer and a midfielder. A Barcelona youth graduate, he also represented Real Madrid, Valencia and the Spanish national team before later working as a manager.
Marc-Oliver Kempf (born 28 January 1995) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Italian Serie A club Como.

Suliman-Marlon Mustapha is a 25-year-old Austrian professional footballer who plays as a center-forward for Serie A club Como 1907. Born on 24 May 2001 in Vienna, the 1.85-metre striker recently returned to his parent Italian club following a loan spell in the Austrian Football Bundesliga.

Mattia Liberali (born 6 April 2007) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder and winger for Serie C Group B club Milan Futuro, the reserve team of Serie A club AC Milan.
Mauro Vigorito (born 22 May 1990) is an Italian professional football player. He plays for Serie A club Como.
Maxence Caqueret (born 15 February 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Italian Serie A club Como.
Máximo Perrone (born 7 January 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Como.
Nicolás Paz Martínez (born 8 September 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Como. Born in Spain, he plays for the Argentina national team.

Robert Lynch Sánchez is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Como, on loan from Premier League club Chelsea. Born in Cartagena, Sánchez began his career with Levante before moving to England to sign for Brighton & Hove Albion at the age of 15, turning professional with them in June 2015.
Anastasios "Tasos" Douvikas (born 2 August 1999) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a forward for Italian Serie A club Como and the Greece national team.
Tommaso Fumagalli is an Italian football player, central attacker for Como.

Trevoh Tom Chalobah (born 5 July 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Como. Born in Sierra Leone, he plays for the England national team. Chalobah is a centre-back who joined Chelsea at the age of eight and progressed through the club's academy. He spent time out on loan with Ipswich Town, Huddersfield Town and French side Lorient.
Yan Bueno Couto (born 3 June 2002) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Serie A club Como, on loan from Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund.
